game.label: Your MOJO! USA PlayStation 2 disc image (SLUS_207.41, SYSTEM.CNF VER 1.02). Exact supported hashes: docs/COMPATIBILITY.md. ISO or lossless single-track CD CHD; standalone also accepts BIN/CUE. First setup downloads about 300 MB of open-source build tools and needs several GB free.

prepare.label: Validating your MOJO! USA disc and building locally

settings.label: Display
settings.help: Native uses the current monitor's desktop resolution. The original aspect ratio is retained.

settings.label: Rendering resolution
settings.help: Gameplay uses 640 × 448 at Original. Other scenes may use a different base resolution. Higher settings need more GPU resources; restart the game after changing.

settings.label: Invert right stick X
settings.help: Reverses horizontal camera input only. Y and ball movement are unchanged. Applies on launch; the F1 menu can also toggle it immediately.

actions.label: Open saves
actions.help: Memory card and controls; never replaced by updates.

exit_codes.20: Unsupported, damaged, or missing disc. Supply your MOJO! USA PS2 SLUS_207.41 disc matching docs/COMPATIBILITY.md.
exit_codes.21: Setup dependency or filesystem error. Check internet access, free space and write permission.
exit_codes.22: Native compilation failed. Retry setup; do not share raw private build logs.
exit_codes.23: Setup exceeded its time limit. Retry when the computer is less busy.
exit_codes.24: This installation is already building or running. Close its other session first.
